extDescription.message: Export AI chats from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude. 32 AI sites, 9 formats, 5 cloud destinations.
extDescription.description: Browser store description; 132 chars max IN EVERY LOCALE, so keep EN under ~95. No enumerated site/format lists. (see CLAUDE.md → Store copy)
